rationale.conceptual: The method is the paper's own research-grade technique (adjoint representation, mixed-phase Monte Carlo, hysteresis analysis). It requires understanding SU(N) group theory, correct generation of Haar measure, Metropolis updates with a non-trivial action, and interpretation of phase coexistence. While lattice gauge theory is now textbook, implementing this specific methodology from scratch still demands substantial domain expertise and careful translation of mathematics into code. This goes beyond a simple standard library call.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two main stages: first, exploratory runs with ordered/disordered starts to map the hysteresis (output logged), then mixed-start runs to pinpoint critical β_c (scored output). The work is linear, uses only NumPy, has trivial I/O, and involves no complex orchestration, external data fetching, or multi-tool integration. The run is self-contained and simple to execute.
